text:
deploy-bot: Promotion to staging blocked for release 2026.3.4. Preflight failed in job build/integration: test-db connection reset (ERR_CONN_RESET) during migrate step. See: https://ci.redwood.example/456

alice: Noted. Which step specifically? migrate or seed?

ci-system: Failed step: `integration:migrate` (container: db-migrate). Logs: `psql: could not connect to server: Connection reset by peer`

ben: I saw a spate of transient DB resets in eu-west runners last 20m. Might be network flaps from the new NAT gateway rollout.

maria: If it's infra, we should fallback to last-good artifact. Manual promote? Or pin to image sha and postpone cut.

alice: +1 to pin image sha for this canary, unblock rollout. We need to avoid a rollback if not necessary.

ben: We can rerun the failing job with `BUILDKITE_RETRY=1` after increasing `PG_CONNECT_TIMEOUT=20` env. Quick patch: `buildkite-agent pipeline upload retry-migrate.yml`

maria: How confident are we this is infra vs a flaky migration script? Any DB schema drift risks if we retry on different DB?

alice: Migration script logs show same SQL executed then error. No partial commits expected. But double-check migration idempotency.

ben: I'll run `psql -c 'SELECT txid_current()'` against staging to verify no half-applied migration.

deploy-bot: Action items: 1) @ben run DB check (ETA 10m). 2) If clean, @alice pin image sha and trigger manual promote. 3) If not clean, rollback staging to last-good snapshot and abort promote. Reply with "ack" to confirm.

maria: ack. I'll stand by for the DB check.

ben: DB check: txids look normal, no open transactions. Looks clean. Logs attached: (snippet)

ben: `2026-03-21T15:12:04Z ERROR: connection reset during startup` — same timeframe as NAT redeploy

alice: Pinning to sha: sha256:3f2a9c4b5d... and triggering manual promote now.

deploy-bot: Manual promote initiated by alice. Canaries will flow after successful canary-smoke.

ci-system: canary-smoke job passed on 3/3 instances.

maria: rolling window remains the same. No rollback required. Thanks all :tada:

alice: I'll open a follow-up ticket to trace NAT gateway redeploy correlation and add retry/backoff to migration step.

ben: filed TICKET-789: investigate eu-west NAT redeploy causing transient DB resets.

alice: closing thread, moving to release notes: add "Mitigated transient DB connection resets during staging canary by pinning image and increasing migrate timeout."
